# **STATE OF MAINE** # **DEPARTMENT OF THE SECRETARY OF STATE** # **Notice of Agency Rulemaking Proposal** **AGENCY:** Department of Marine Resources **CHAPTER NUMBER AND RULE TITLE:** Chapter 34, Groundfish [Whiting/Silver Hake (*Merluccius bilinearis*) Commercial Effort Restrictions] **TYPE OF RULE:** Routine Technical **PROPOSAL FILING NUMBER:** 2026-P188 **BRIEF SUMMARY:** This proposed rulemaking seeks to modify the coastal waters gear restrictions to align with federal regulations (50 CFR §648.80(a)(16)). This proposed rulemaking clarifies grate raised footrope trawl (GRFT) net measurements. It also removes the requirement for a Department of Marine Resources gear inspection and the need to obtain a whiting endorsement prior to participating in the fishery. **PUBLIC HEARING:** None. **COMMENT DEADLINE:** Sunday, September 13, 2026 **CONTACT PERSON FOR THIS FILING:** Name: Aurora Burgess Mailing Address: 21 State House Station, Augusta, ME 04333 Telephone Number: 207-592-0295 Fax Number: 207-624-6024 TTY Number: 877-243-2823, TTY 711 Email Address: DMR.rulemaking@maine.gov **CONTACT PERSON FOR SMALL BUSINESS IMPACT STATEMENT:** Same. **FINANCIAL IMPACT ON MUNICIPALITIES OR COUNTIES:** None **STATUTORY AUTHORITY FOR THIS RULE:** 12 M.R.S. §6171 **SUBSTANTIVE STATE OR FEDERAL LAW BEING IMPLEMENTED:** Same. **AGENCY WEBSITE:** https://www.maine.gov/dmr/rules-enforcement/regulations-rules **EMAIL ADDRESS FOR OVERALL AGENCY RULEMAKING LIAISON:** DMR.rulemaking@maine.gov
